name: Zhege Jiahuo Wuzui
source:
Step into the shoes of the main character, rookie lawyer Luna Ray, and navigate her journey through the legal world. Unravel a shocking conspiracy that changes the fate of many, including herself, and confront her inner choices.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2983140]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演主角新秀律师卢娜·雷 (Luna Ray)，带领她穿越法律世界。揭开一个改变许多人（包括她自己）命运的令人震惊的阴谋，并面对她内心的选择。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2983140]Steam[/url]]
